I’m honored to have President @realDonaldTrump’s complete and total endorsement.

On June 9th, voters will send a clear message: the people of South Carolina stand with President Trump.

Video

Ending day 1 of our Get Out the Vote tour in Easley, SC. 

Republicans are ready to stand united with President Trump and his agenda.

Congratulations to @schighwaypatrol Trooper R.A. Lee on being named 2026 National Trooper of the Year by the American Association of State Troopers. He is the first South Carolina Highway Patrol trooper to receive this award.
 
Lance Corporal Lee was recognized for stopping a speeding, stolen car that was traveling the wrong way on the interstate from Charlotte into South Carolina by using his own vehicle to stop the speeding car.
 
We are extremely grateful for Lance Corporal Lee’s heroic actio

I very much appreciate President Trump’s desire to end the Iranian conflict with a diplomatic solution that is real and sustainable.
 
I have complete confidence in President Trump and his team to achieve this shared goal.
 
However, the biggest news out of the cabinet meeting is President Trump’s determination to expand the Abraham Accords, to include Saudia Arabia making peace with Isreal. This would be the biggest change in the Middle East in thousands of years, effectively ending the Arab-Is

Just left early voting and was joined by a packed house here in Anderson County. 

Thank you for your support, and don’t forget to go vote!

I just voted early. Have you?

Don't wait until Primary Day. Bank your vote today! Find your polling site at: LindseyGraham.com/vote.

God bless.

I also want to thank President Trump for his Executive Order that protects the American people from illegal alien fraudsters and other criminals who are taking advantage of the American financial system. 

I fully support President Trump and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent in safeguarding the country’s financial system from cross border money transfers that can be used for terrorist financing and drug trafficking. 

Illegal aliens, traffickers, and money launderers have taken advantage of the A

During a February Judiciary hearing on fraud, I warned the governor of Minnesota and state officials of the consequences of shutting down investigations into allegations of fraudulent activity within government funded programs. 

I’m glad that swift action has been taken by the Trump Administration to stop these scams.

We have seen daycare facilities that don’t provide daycare, healthcare funding going to services that were not provided, and state and federal funds meant to feed children that i

Big thank you to President Trump, Vice President Vance, and the hardworking men and women of the DOJ, FBI, HHS, Treasury Department for cracking down on massive healthcare fraud and abuse of the financial system that is costing American taxpayers billions of dollars.

The White House Task Force to Eliminate Fraud will stop scammers from continuing to drive up healthcare costs. 

It is an unacceptable fact that every dollar stolen through fraud is taken from the pockets of hard working tax-paying

It has been apparent to me for quite a while that Pakistan as a mediator is more than problematic. Their animosity towards Israel is long standing. 
 
It is undeniable that Iranian military aircraft are being housed on Pakistani air bases and past rhetoric from the highest Pakistani officials against Israel is disturbing. 
 
As to the defense minister’s comments about the Abraham Accords, saying that Pakistan would never join because they don’t trust Israel: The clip may be a year old, but I fea

As a U.S. Senator representing South Carolina, I’m honored to work with constituents and leaders to make life better for people across South Carolina, in towns big and small. While Washington bureaucrats too often neglect the needs of rural areas, I’ve made it a priority to deliver for these communities.

When Westminster officials approached my office with their proposal to upgrade the city’s water treatment plant, I was determined to secure the resources to make it possible. In order for this

Early Voting begins TODAY, South Carolina!

Don't wait. Make your plan to vote. Visit LindseyGraham.com/vote to find your polling site. 🇺🇸

We will never forget Sheridan Gorman and all the victims of illegal immigrant criminals who should have never been in this country in the first place. President Trump is totally right, Sanctuary Cities protect criminals and allow them to roam free.

This is why I introduced the End Sanctuary Cities Act to make sure that no more American families face the tragedy that the Gorman family has had to suffer. 

So-called Sanctuary Cities protect criminals, period. 

I am working closely with the White

Spent the afternoon at the Greenville County Memorial Day ceremony, which commemorated the 250th anniversary of the Revolutionary War. 

It was a fitting tribute to the patriots - spanning generations - that gave their lives in service of our great nation and in defense of our freedom.

Very sad to hear of the passing of my good friend Doug McCain, the oldest son of Senator McCain. Doug was an American Patriot, a Navy pilot like his father, and had an outstanding career as an airline pilot. Doug loved his country, his wonderful family and will be missed by us all. His passing was way too soon. Rest in Peace my friend.

President Trump’s most recent proposal requiring expansion of the Abraham Accords as part of a negotiated settlement to the Iran conflict is simply brilliant and would result in the most significant change in the Middle East in thousands of years. 

With Saudi Arabia and others like Pakistan making peace with Israel, the region will know a level of stability never dreamed of before President Trump and will eventually lead to regional integration making the Middle East a powerhouse for economic o

On Memorial Day, we pause as a nation to honor the brave men and women who gave their lives in defense of our freedom. Across generations, more than a million Americans have made the ultimate sacrifice so that our country might endure and our values might prevail.

Their courage secured the liberties we too often take for granted. Their sacrifice binds us together in gratitude and solemn remembrance.

Sen. Lindsey Graham signaled strong support for President Donald Trump's emerging Iran strategy Sunday, arguing that any long-term agreement with Tehran should be tied to a dramatic expansion of the Abraham Accords that would include Saudi Arabia and other major Muslim nations normalizing relations with Israel.

newsmax.com/newsfront/lindse…

If in fact as a result of these negotiations to end the Iranian conflict, our Arab and Muslim allies in the region agreed to join the Abraham Accords, it would make this agreement one of the most consequential in the history of the Middle East. 

Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Pakistan joining the Abraham Accords would be beyond transformative for the region and world. It is a brilliant move by President Trump. 

To Saudi Arabia and others: Now is the time to be bold for the future of a new Middle Eas

If it is perceived in the region that a deal with Iran allows the regime to survive and become more powerful over time, we will have poured gasoline on the conflicts in Lebanon and Iraq. 

A deal that is perceived to allow Iran to survive and possess the ability to control the Strait in the future will put Hezbollah in Lebanon and the Shia militias in Iraq on steroids.
